results.fact: Protection: fully bolted vs knob threads
results.correct_value: Bolted throughout to chain anchors (12 draws); a few knobs can optionally be slung. No trad gear.
results.evidence: The route page lists quickdraws and alpine draws (12 total) as the protection, with bolts on every pitch and chains; it mentions slinging a few rocks on P3. A club trip report calls the route so heavily bolted it is hard to get lost, with chicken heads slung only by choice for practice and almost no use for nuts or cams. So the route is bolted throughout; knob threads are optional, not part of a 'mixed' protection scheme.

patches.fact: Protection: fully bolted vs knob threads
patches.replace: bolted throughout, with the option to sling an occasional knob.
